test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting clockwise around a circular table facing the centre in the same sequence at equal distances between them. If H is sitting in the North direction, then in which direction is D sitting?
solution:
Eight friends** A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H** are sitting clockwise around a circular table facing the centre in the same sequence at equal distances between them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0461647215920ee8986f23cb5057ba3492a9d7ce8cf9076e9e6efb46c58f81b.png] 

If H is sitting in the North direction, D is sitting in the South direction.

Hence, '**South**' is the correct answer.
